Guidance & outlook: Return on assets stood at 1.88% in FY26. x In our life insurance business, individual first year premium grew 15% year-on-year to ₹ 4,725 Crore and group new business premium increased 31% year- on-year to ₹ 7,314 Crore in FY26.
Between FY23 and FY26, the lending portfolio grew at a CAGR of 30% CAGR to over ₹ 2 Lakh Crore.

Consolidated PAT1 (₹ in Cr) 23% FY23 FY26 3,797 2,057 Consolidated revenue2 (₹ in Cr) 22% FY23 FY26 53,871 29,999 Assets under management4 (₹ in Cr) 18% FY23 FY26 5,91,343 3,59,922 Lending book3 (₹ in Cr) 30% FY23 FY26 2,07,368 94,364 Gross premium5 (₹ in Cr) 21% FY23 FY26 31,634 17,787 1.
Growth & demand: The volume of world merchandise trade grew by 4.6%, compared to a forecast of 2.4%.

For the second consecutive year, Asian economies were the largest contributors to total world trade volume growth, accounting for 3.2 percentage points of the 4.6% total - or 71% of the overall increase.
On the demand side, private consumption grew 7.7% year-on-year, supported by income tax reductions and rationalisation of GST rates.
